edits.content: When a user answers a travel-date question with one date for an already requested single-destination flight-and-hotel trip, use it as the flight departure date and hotel check-in date unless the conversation specifies otherwise; if a hotel duration is stated, derive checkout before deciding whether information is missing. When a hotel is requested at the destination of an outbound itinerary leg and the conversation gives that leg's travel date plus a later checkout date but no separate check-in, use the outbound travel date as check-in; do not apply this to an occasion date or when distinct lodging dates are provided.
